authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-cc-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/cc-synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a controller the manual lists, on the number it gives, with the name it prints. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Roland prints no value ranges for these controllers, so each is 0 - 127 on the wire unless a note below says the manual prints otherwise; a switch is a number until the instrument shows where its positions fall.
CC 15 is named "OSC PULSE WIDTH ([SHIFT] button + [PWM DEPTH] pad) ([SHIFT] +OSCILLATOR [PULSE] knob)": the manual prints the pulse-wave icon here (p74), which the text layer drops
CC 19 is named "OSC PULSE LEVEL (OSCILLATOR [PULSE] knob)": the manual prints the pulse-wave icon here (p74), which the text layer drops
CC 20 is named "OSC SAW LEVEL (OSCILLATOR [SAW] knob)": the manual prints the sawtooth icon here (p74), which the text layer drops
CC 102 is named "OSC DRAW MULTIPLY ([SHIFT] button + pad [5] (OSC DRAW): MULTIPLY) ([SHIFT] + OSCILLATOR [PULSE] knob)": the manual prints the pulse-wave icon here (p74), which the text layer drops
CC 107 is named "OSC DRAW SW ([SHIFT] button + pad [5] (OSC DRAW): SW) ([SHIFT] + OSCILLATOR [SAW] knob)": the manual prints the sawtooth icon here (p74), which the text layer drops
